Name: Kenneth's Restaurant
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Restaurant[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds 50+ plated foods to Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Bowls like Bowl of Buttered Popcorn, Bowl of Cheese Puffs, Bowl of Creamy Egg Salad, Bowl of Hot Ramen Noodles, Bowl of Potato Chips, Bowl of Triple Scoop Ice Cream[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Fast Food like Plated Bean Burrito, Plated Cheeseburger on Napkin, Plated Classic Cheeseburger, Plated Club Sandwich, Plated Crispy Taco, Plated Hot Dog, Plated Cheeseburger and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Desserts like Plated Caramel Flan, Plated Cheesecake with Strawberry, Plated Chocolate Cake Slice, Plated Chocolate Chip Cookies, Plated Cinnamon Donuts, Plated Egg Tarts, Plated Holiday Fruitcake, Plated Lemon Pie Slice, Plated Strawberry Cake Slice, Plated Waffle with Cream and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Main Dishes like Plated Crispy Bacon, Plated Curry with Rice, Plated Salmon Fillet, Plated Steak with Veggies, Plated Meatball Spaghetti, Plated Sushi Duo[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Breads like Plated Garlic Bread, Plated Gingerbread Men[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Other foods like Jar of Red Berry Jam, Plated Bagel with Lox, Plated Dark Chocolate Bar, Plated French Fries with Ketchup, Plated Giant Gummy Bear[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Items like Empty White Plate - needed to buy foods via trade[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All items have cooking recipes and can be turned on or off in GMCM[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All foods are sold in Kenneth's Restaurant building. The building has shops with different selections.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Building Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm,  Kenneth's Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Grocery Store[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Fruit Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Vegetable Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for toggling recipes[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
